summary: Add a track to the user's favorites
description: Adds the specified track to the authenticated user's Favorites playlist. No error is returned if the track does not exist; it simply will not appear in subsequent read requests. Requires a valid client_id and an OAuth2 access token with the 'music' scope.

requestBody.name: client_id
requestBody.description: A Client Id provided by the Jamendo developer portal.

requestBody.name: fullcount
requestBody.description: If true, the response header includes the 'results_fullcount' value for pagination.

requestBody.name: access_token
requestBody.description: A valid OAuth2 access token with the 'music' scope for the target user.

requestBody.name: track_id
requestBody.description: The numeric ID of the track to add to favorites.

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request, including status, code, and result counts.

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: An array of result objects; empty for this endpoint.

notes: If the provided track_id does not correspond to an existing track, the call succeeds silently with an empty results array.
Both client_id and access_token must be supplied; client_id serves as the API key while access_token provides user authentication.
